tasks.title: °/s from Actual rates
tasks.statement: The configuration has `rates_type = ACTUAL`, `roll_rc_rate = {rc}`, `roll_srate = {sr}`, `roll_expo = {ex}`. The roll stick is deflected to **{x}** of full travel. What roll rate is the pilot commanding, °/s?
tasks.solution: C = rc_rate·10, M = srate·10, e = expo/100. `applyActualRates` (Betaflight 2025.12, `fc/rc.c`): ω = C·x + (M − C)·|x|·(x⁵·e + x·(1 − e)). For 15/60/40 and x = 0.5 you get 145.3 °/s.

tasks.title: Time of flips at full stick
tasks.statement: An Actual profile, `roll_srate = {sr}`. How many seconds will **{n}** full roll rotations take at full stick (ignore the acceleration)?
tasks.solution: At full stick (x = 1) the Actual model gives exactly M = srate·10 °/s at any expo. t = n·360/M. For 60 and one rotation — 0.60 s.

tasks.title: Turn radius
tasks.statement: The aircraft flies a level turn without losing altitude at a speed of **{v} m/s** with a roll of **{phi}°**. Find the turn radius, m (g = 9.81 m/s²).

tasks.title: Turn rate in a turn
tasks.statement: A turn without losing altitude: speed **{v} m/s**, roll **{phi}°**. At what angular rate is the aircraft turning, °/s (g = 9.81 m/s²)?
tasks.solution: ω = g·tan φ/v in rad/s, then ×57.3. For 10 m/s and 45°: 0.981 rad/s = 56 °/s. Thrust must grow by a factor of 1/cos φ: 1.15 at 30°, 1.41 at 45°, 2.0 at 60°.
